title: gravitas.assignment/2
description: A short assignment cut from an investigation, as its downloaded file holds it and as its link carries it after the `a` tag is decoded: the lesson, its steps in lesson order with a fingerprint each, the instructor's title and introduction, the day it was made, and, from version 2, the capability package the lesson came from. Short keys, because a link is the first place it goes. It carries no answers and nobody's work, and a field that could hold them is refused. js/assignments/assignment.js validateAssignment() is the authority, and reads version 1 as it is. It also holds the fingerprints to one per step, which a schema cannot say, and reads a version given as text; it does not look inside a fingerprint or at the date. FORMATS.md lists it.

v.description: 1, or 2 when the assignment names its package (`p`).

i.description: The assignment's id: a date and a hash of its lesson, steps and title, so the same activity issued again keeps its students' work.

s.description: The steps, by their permanent ids, in lesson order. A colon would collide with the sub-keys progress is stored under.

f.description: A short hash of each step's fingerprint, in the order of `s`: enough to notice that a step was rewritten under its own id.

p.description: The capability package the lesson came from, and its version.

d.description: The depth the item is set at (Prompt 72); steps deeper than it are not shown.
